tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO, the frame filled by five centimetres of wall - disregard every presenting-toward-camera, whole-hand and soft-background instruction. The chiselled tip drags a thick dusty-rose stroke across the trowel ridges, pigment skipping the crests and packing the hollows, a crumb of cream curling at the tail. VERSE sits laser-etched into the metal collar, large and cleanly legible at this magnification, taking one hard highlight along its strokes. 100mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, lens square to the wall at stroke height; an out-of-focus knuckle crosses the bottom-left corner and is cut by it. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
